get.description: records.read; one SQLite snapshot of non-retired completed records. Range must be positive and at most 366 days. Fixed-offset date buckets and at most 200 user groups per page. Totals keep measured duration, lower bounds and unknown duration separate.

200.description: RecordSummary: totals; days[{date,totals}]; users[{userId,totals}]; nextUserId. Totals contain runs/succeeded/failed/cancelled/unverified/measuredCount/measuredMilliseconds/lowerBoundCount/unknownDurationCount. Null user identifies script-group runs.
